name: feature-add-hidden-test
prompt: Implement the Compare function in semver.go according to its doc comment. Replace the panic with a working implementation.
notes: The specification is the doc comment; the test is withheld and applied afterwards. Writing to a visible test invites fitting the test rather than the spec, which measures the wrong thing. The hidden cases cover what a careless implementation gets wrong: numeric rather than lexical ordering, the optional v prefix, short versions, and unparseable input.
